item.title: Slender crystal's blue-to-yellow glow could make invisible forces visible
item.description: Applying pressure to luminescent organic crystals usually brings molecules closer together and weakens their fluorescence. Materials that instead brighten and undergo a large color change are rare, and clear design principles for achieving both responses in simple, rigid aromatic hydrocarbons have been lacking. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: What can a pair of underpants tell you about your vegetable garden?
item.description: This summer, 115 participants in Leiden and The Hague worked with scientists from Leiden University to investigate the soil life in their community garden plots. With mangetout peas, a taste test, a buried pair of underpants and a harvest festival, they helped scientists better understand the connection between soil, plants and people. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Show HN: HomeCat – Design your backyard office
item.description: Hey HN! Ilya and Nikita here. We’re building HomeCat, a tool that lets you design a backyard office space - https://myhomecat.com We started out by helping people design sheds, and quickly realized that many people actually want to build a backyard office. There wasn't really an easy way to do this, so we thought we'd take on the challenge. Right now, you can design a backyard shed and our tool will make it code compliant. It's maybe 90% of the way there, since you also have zoning/HOA and other edge cases. But it does figure out most of the details for you. Right now, it's pretty simple… Fuente: Hacker News - Portada.

item.title: Neutrophil vesicles help Candida albicans evade immune-cell engulfment
item.description: The immune system is a highly sophisticated defense network designed to protect against pathogens. A research team from the Universities of Würzburg and Jena and the Leibniz Institute for Natural Product Research and Infection Biology (Leibniz-HKI) has shown that certain components of the immune system can actually help the yeast Candida albicans evade immune attack. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Reversible electric control unlocks persistent chiral phonon states
item.description: Atoms in a material are rarely still. They jiggle back and forth in collective lattice vibrations known as phonons. Their motion can also carry a rotational element: In 2023, scientists at PSI experimentally proved the existence of chiral phonons, which exhibit handedness depending on which way they rotate. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: New report offers lessons for preserving cultural heritage in crisis zones
item.description: The report, "Digital heritage preservation for vulnerable collections: Reflections on the Sudan Memory project history and inventory," was authored by Dr. Laura Gibson, senior lecturer in digital content management education at King's, alongside Sara El-Nager, independent researcher and editor, and Dr. Hannah Ishmael, lecturer in digital culture & race. It draws on 14 interviews conducted by El-Nager with contributors to the Sudan Memory project, the first mass digitization project ever undertaken in Sudan. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: Friedrich Merz said his conservative CDU was shaken ‘to its very foundations’ after far-right victory in Saxony-Anhalt A “shocked” and chastened Friedrich Merz has vowed to stay in office despite the far right’s triumph in a state election that has brought anti-immigrant, pro-Kremlin politicians within striking distance of power.
